content.text:
Help text now sits to the right of the chat input's tabs and says what the selected tab is for. It changes as soon as you pick another tab. 95 of 96 tests pass, including a new one for the help text; the one failure is the palette test that was already failing. `piton check` and `piton build check` pass. I haven't looked at it in the running app.

| Tab | Help text |
|---|---|
| Code | Changes the code, leaving the spec as it is. |
| Chain | Changes the code and the spec together. |
| Spec | Changes the spec, leaving the code as it is. |
| Ask | Asks a question about the code and the spec, changing neither. |

- **Look:** small, muted text filling the rest of the tab bar. It's cut off rather than wrapped if the window is narrow.
- **Ask tab width:** Ask used to stretch to the right edge of the bar. To make room, it's now a normal-width tab. Its green tint now covers only the tab itself, not the rest of the bar.
- **Test:** checks the text sits right of the Ask tab and fills the rest of the bar, that each tab has its own text, and that selecting a tab shows that tab's text.
- **Spec:** `ChatInputScope` has a new help section with the four sentences word for word, and no longer says Ask stretches to the right edge.

The wording is mine, so change any of it that doesn't read right. It lives in `SendMode::help` in `src/chat_input.rs`.

The Gmail, Google Calendar and Google Drive connectors still need authorizing in your claude.ai connector settings before they'll work. Nothing here needed them.
